item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: GDS就NHS退出开源决定公开表态
item.description:
标签: #开源 #政府 #AI安全

摘要: 英国政府数字服务局（GDS）近日明确建议公共部门应坚持"默认开放"原则，认为代码私有化将增加交付成本并削弱审查与重用；尽管未直接点名，但该表态被普遍视为对英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）退出开源决定的罕见公开批评。

原标题: GDS weighs in on the NHS's decision to retreat from Open Source

GDS weighs in on the NHS's decision to retreat from Open Source

GDS（英国政府数字服务）就 NHS（英国国家医疗服务体系）退出 Open Source（开源）领域的决定表态

Now the Government Digital Service have joined the conversation withAI, open code and vulnerability risk in the public sector, published May 14th. Their key recommendation:
Keep open by default. Making everything private adds additional delivery and policy costs, and can reduce reuse and scrutiny. Openness should remain the default posture, with closure used sparingly and deliberately.

英国 Government Digital Service（政府数字服务，GDS）于5月14日就 AI（人工智能）、open code（开放代码）以及 vulnerability risk（漏洞风险）等议题加入公共部门（public sector）的相关讨论。他们的核心建议如下：

默认保持开放。将所有内容私有化会增加额外的交付与政策成本，并可能降低复用性与审查力度。开放应继续作为默认姿态，而封闭则应谨慎且有意识地使用。
Keep open by default. Making everything private adds additional delivery and policy costs, and can reduce reuse and scrutiny. Openness should remain the default posture, with closure used sparingly and deliberately.

默认保持 open by default（默认开放）。将所有内容私有化会增加额外的交付与政策成本，并可能降低复用性与 scrutiny（审查力度）。开放应继续作为默认姿态，而封闭则应谨慎且有意识地使用。

While they don't mention the NHS by name, Terence Eden speaks the language of the civil service and interprets this as a major escalation:
Within the UK's Civil Service you occasionally hear the expression "being invited to a meetingwithout biscuits". It implies a rather frosty discussion without any of the polite niceties of a normal meeting. In general though, even when people have severe disagreements, it is rare for tempers to fray. It is even rarer for those internal disagreements to spill over into public.

尽管文中并未点名 NHS（英国国家医疗服务体系），但 Terence Eden（泰伦斯·伊登）以 civil service（英国公务员体系）的措辞风格解读称，这是一次重大升级：

在英国 Civil Service（公务员体系）中，你偶尔会听到“被邀请参加一个没有饼干的会议”（being invited to a meeting without biscuits）这种说法。它暗示着一场相当冷淡的讨论，没有任何正常会议中的礼貌客套。不过一般来说，即使人们存在严重分歧，也很少会情绪失控。而这些 internal disagreements（内部分歧）公开化则更为罕见。
